import json, urllib.request
assign_url='http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments'
tabs_url='http://127.0.0.1:17410/json/list'
branches=[
'agent/bridge-r43-porcelain-cutover-fix-20261006',
'agent/native-mcp-r39-local-canary-20261006',
'agent/media-r27-real-input-local-rehearsal-20261006',
'agent/creator-r39-current-authority-binder-20261006',
'agent/growth-r38-real-local-bundle-verifier-20261006',
'agent/integration-r8-final-local-stack-20261006'
]
a=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(assign_url,timeout=12).read().decode('utf-8'))
tabs=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(tabs_url,timeout=8).read().decode('utf-8'))
rows=[]
for x in a.get('assignments',[]):
    txt=json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)
    if any(b in txt for b in branches):
        rows.append({k:x.get(k) for k in [
            'id','managedChatId','providerConversationId','logicalAgentId','state',
            'lastPreflightReason','lastDiagnostic','dispatchCount','dispatchSubmitAttempted',
            'currentHead','expectedBranch','updatedAt'
        ]})
outtabs=[]
for t in tabs:
    u=str(t.get('url',''))
    if 'chatgpt.com' in u:
        outtabs.append({'id':t.get('id'),'title':t.get('title'),'url':u,'type':t.get('type')})
print(json.dumps({'assignments':rows,'tabs':outtabs},ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')))
